remarks: Immaculate, updated and Pet-friendly! This beautifully renovated & immaculately presented home is available for occupancy and can be rented furnished or unfurnished. An easy open flow of character-filled rooms invites sunny & comfortable everyday living and inspired entertaining for those special events. Be the first to enjoy the sparkling kitchen with new stainless appliances, built-ins, butcher block countertops & breakfast area. Open the kitchen door to the private patio with majestic rock surround. Upstairs, you'll enjoy 4 generous bedrooms, including a romantic primary bedroom with fireplace, lounge area & very pretty & new full bath. This home has idyllic, expansive property featuring a small pond and welcomes pets.
